origine_fr: Une main 扌 et 尧, qui donnait le son mais se lit yáo, loin de náo. 挠 veut dire « troubler ». La main qui dérange a donné gratter, 挠痒, et entraver, 阻挠.
origine_en: A hand 扌 and 尧, which gave the sound but is read yáo, far from náo. 挠 means “to disturb”. The hand that disturbs gave to scratch, 挠痒, and to hinder, 阻挠.

phrase.zh: 他挠了挠头，不知道说什么。
phrase.pinyin: Tā náo le náo tóu, bù zhīdao shuō shénme.
phrase.fr: Il s'est gratté la tête, sans savoir quoi dire.
phrase.en: He scratched his head, not knowing what to say.
